item.title: KATSEYE Sweat It Out in Colorful, Rain-Drenched ‘Hootie Fruitti’ Video: Watch
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to Trending on Billboard! Today, we're talking about the latest music video from KATSEYE, 'Hootie Fruitti'. This high-energy visual is a must-see, with a Latin-influenced beat and some serious dance moves."
[Short music clip plays]
Host: "The video, directed by Alfred Marroquin, features the group performing in a sweat-drenched underground dance party. With their signature choreography and catchy lyrics, it's hard not to move along with the music. The song itself is all about being the center of attention, with lines like 'Hey cutie, cutie, I see ya lookin'' and 'I know you like that, Hootie fruitti'."
[Short music clip plays]
Host: "The video also features the group's energetic performance, with the members dressed in colorful bikinis and one-pieces. At one point, the party even turns into a rain-drenched throw-down, complete with sprinklers and an improvised car-trunk swimming pool. It's a fun and carefree visual that's sure to get you moving."
[Short music clip plays]
Host: "KATSEYE's 'Hootie Fruitti' is part of their latest EP, WILD, which follows their Grammy-nominated BEAUTIFUL CHAOS. The group is set to hit the road on their WILDWORLD TOUR, starting on September 1st in Dublin. And if you can't wait to see them live, you can check out their concert film, KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS, which is currently playing in over 1,700 cinemas worldwide."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's it for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Thanks for tuning in, and don't forget to check out KATSEYE's 'Hootie Fruitti' video and get ready to dance!"
